name: Pro Dodge & Burn (50% Gray)
description: Creates a non-destructive 50% Gray Soft Light layer with a B&W visual aid layer for professional Dodge & Burn contouring.
description_ru: Создает недеструктивный слой 50% серого в режиме Soft Light со вспомогательным Ч/Б слоем для профессиональной светотеневой прорисовки объемов.
author: kobaltGIT

commands.description: Set foreground color to 50% neutral gray
Set blend mode to Soft Light (neutral gray becomes fully invisible)
Add Black & White adjustment layer as non-destructive visual aid
Name helper layer Visual Aid (B&W Helper)
Select Dodge & Burn working layer below
Set brush colors: White (Dodge) foreground, Black (Burn) background
